groups.coverage: 阶段性结果：69个run、207路视频尚未完成三视角全程观看。全量4195条轨迹和38348控制步已重新核对；207路视频完整解码、690源文件哈希通过。18项视觉指标逐run标pending，不能按NA或0统计；旧版局部事件证据另存。
methodology: 阶段性结果：69个run、207路视频尚未完成三视角全程观看。全量4195条轨迹和38348控制步已重新核对；207路视频完整解码、690源文件哈希通过。18项视觉指标逐run标pending，不能按NA或0统计；旧版局部事件证据另存。
动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。
去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
空夹包括无重试尝试；主动释放后落下不计掉落。
没有已知公开原始媒体URL，证据以三视角sha256、帧号和执行区间登记。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。
audit_auxiliary.coverage: 阶段性结果：69个run、207路视频尚未完成三视角全程观看。全量4195条轨迹和38348控制步已重新核对；207路视频完整解码、690源文件哈希通过。18项视觉指标逐run标pending，不能按NA或0统计；旧版局部事件证据另存。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。
audit_auxiliary.coverage: 阶段性结果：69个run、207路视频尚未完成三视角全程观看。全量4195条轨迹和38348控制步已重新核对；207路视频完整解码、690源文件哈希通过。18项视觉指标逐run标pending，不能按NA或0统计；旧版局部事件证据另存。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

E0467.uncertainty: 整项任务action上限未提供，不能根据模型声称的剩余steps计算使用率。

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。
audit_auxiliary.coverage: 阶段性结果：69个run、207路视频尚未完成三视角全程观看。全量4195条轨迹和38348控制步已重新核对；207路视频完整解码、690源文件哈希通过。18项视觉指标逐run标pending，不能按NA或0统计；旧版局部事件证据另存。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

E0037.uncertainty: 无法可靠区分未离开支撑面的空夹与短暂夹持后失持；不纳入两类计数。

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

E0469.uncertainty: 整项任务action上限未提供，不能根据模型声称的剩余steps计算使用率。

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。
audit_auxiliary.coverage: 阶段性结果：69个run、207路视频尚未完成三视角全程观看。全量4195条轨迹和38348控制步已重新核对；207路视频完整解码、690源文件哈希通过。18项视觉指标逐run标pending，不能按NA或0统计；旧版局部事件证据另存。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。
audit_auxiliary.coverage: 阶段性结果：69个run、207路视频尚未完成三视角全程观看。全量4195条轨迹和38348控制步已重新核对；207路视频完整解码、690源文件哈希通过。18项视觉指标逐run标pending，不能按NA或0统计；旧版局部事件证据另存。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。
audit_auxiliary.coverage: 阶段性结果：69个run、207路视频尚未完成三视角全程观看。全量4195条轨迹和38348控制步已重新核对；207路视频完整解码、690源文件哈希通过。18项视觉指标逐run标pending，不能按NA或0统计；旧版局部事件证据另存。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。
audit_auxiliary.coverage: 阶段性结果：69个run、207路视频尚未完成三视角全程观看。全量4195条轨迹和38348控制步已重新核对；207路视频完整解码、690源文件哈希通过。18项视觉指标逐run标pending，不能按NA或0统计；旧版局部事件证据另存。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。
audit_auxiliary.coverage: 阶段性结果：69个run、207路视频尚未完成三视角全程观看。全量4195条轨迹和38348控制步已重新核对；207路视频完整解码、690源文件哈希通过。18项视觉指标逐run标pending，不能按NA或0统计；旧版局部事件证据另存。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。
audit_auxiliary.coverage: 阶段性结果：69个run、207路视频尚未完成三视角全程观看。全量4195条轨迹和38348控制步已重新核对；207路视频完整解码、690源文件哈希通过。18项视觉指标逐run标pending，不能按NA或0统计；旧版局部事件证据另存。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

E0446.uncertainty: 无法区分手臂与物体接触、持物与物体接触，且箱子仅位移，不能记碰倒。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。
audit_auxiliary.coverage: 阶段性结果：69个run、207路视频尚未完成三视角全程观看。全量4195条轨迹和38348控制步已重新核对；207路视频完整解码、690源文件哈希通过。18项视觉指标逐run标pending，不能按NA或0统计；旧版局部事件证据另存。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。
audit_auxiliary.coverage: 阶段性结果：69个run、207路视频尚未完成三视角全程观看。全量4195条轨迹和38348控制步已重新核对；207路视频完整解码、690源文件哈希通过。18项视觉指标逐run标pending，不能按NA或0统计；旧版局部事件证据另存。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。
audit_auxiliary.coverage: 阶段性结果：69个run、207路视频尚未完成三视角全程观看。全量4195条轨迹和38348控制步已重新核对；207路视频完整解码、690源文件哈希通过。18项视觉指标逐run标pending，不能按NA或0统计；旧版局部事件证据另存。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

E0481.uncertainty: 整项任务action上限未提供，不能根据模型声称的剩余steps计算使用率。

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。
audit_auxiliary.coverage: 阶段性结果：69个run、207路视频尚未完成三视角全程观看。全量4195条轨迹和38348控制步已重新核对；207路视频完整解码、690源文件哈希通过。18项视觉指标逐run标pending，不能按NA或0统计；旧版局部事件证据另存。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。
audit_auxiliary.coverage: 阶段性结果：69个run、207路视频尚未完成三视角全程观看。全量4195条轨迹和38348控制步已重新核对；207路视频完整解码、690源文件哈希通过。18项视觉指标逐run标pending，不能按NA或0统计；旧版局部事件证据另存。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。

audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。
audit_auxiliary.coverage: 阶段性结果：69个run、207路视频尚未完成三视角全程观看。全量4195条轨迹和38348控制步已重新核对；207路视频完整解码、690源文件哈希通过。18项视觉指标逐run标pending，不能按NA或0统计；旧版局部事件证据另存。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。
audit_auxiliary.coverage: 阶段性结果：69个run、207路视频尚未完成三视角全程观看。全量4195条轨迹和38348控制步已重新核对；207路视频完整解码、690源文件哈希通过。18项视觉指标逐run标pending，不能按NA或0统计；旧版局部事件证据另存。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。
audit_auxiliary.coverage: 阶段性结果：69个run、207路视频尚未完成三视角全程观看。全量4195条轨迹和38348控制步已重新核对；207路视频完整解码、690源文件哈希通过。18项视觉指标逐run标pending，不能按NA或0统计；旧版局部事件证据另存。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

E0491.uncertainty: 整项任务action上限未提供，不能根据模型声称的剩余steps计算使用率。

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。
audit_auxiliary.coverage: 阶段性结果：69个run、207路视频尚未完成三视角全程观看。全量4195条轨迹和38348控制步已重新核对；207路视频完整解码、690源文件哈希通过。18项视觉指标逐run标pending，不能按NA或0统计；旧版局部事件证据另存。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

E0122.uncertainty: 接收臂在首次提拉中即失持，未证实稳定保持并继续搬运；成功数不计。

E0492.uncertainty: 整项任务action上限未提供，不能根据模型声称的剩余steps计算使用率。放弃理由仅说budget，无法确认特指turn预算。

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。
audit_auxiliary.coverage: 阶段性结果：69个run、207路视频尚未完成三视角全程观看。全量4195条轨迹和38348控制步已重新核对；207路视频完整解码、690源文件哈希通过。18项视觉指标逐run标pending，不能按NA或0统计；旧版局部事件证据另存。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。
audit_auxiliary.coverage: 阶段性结果：69个run、207路视频尚未完成三视角全程观看。全量4195条轨迹和38348控制步已重新核对；207路视频完整解码、690源文件哈希通过。18项视觉指标逐run标pending，不能按NA或0统计；旧版局部事件证据另存。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。
audit_auxiliary.coverage: 阶段性结果：69个run、207路视频尚未完成三视角全程观看。全量4195条轨迹和38348控制步已重新核对；207路视频完整解码、690源文件哈希通过。18项视觉指标逐run标pending，不能按NA或0统计；旧版局部事件证据另存。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。
audit_auxiliary.coverage: 阶段性结果：69个run、207路视频尚未完成三视角全程观看。全量4195条轨迹和38348控制步已重新核对；207路视频完整解码、690源文件哈希通过。18项视觉指标逐run标pending，不能按NA或0统计；旧版局部事件证据另存。

configuration.semantic_eef.prompt: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.

audit_auxiliary.turn_definition: 去重后的非空decision_index计为model turn，显示编号为decision_index+1。72条defer_llm及2条自动give_up不计模型turn。轨迹记录数、宏执行阶段数另列。
audit_auxiliary.action_definition: 仅累计native_controls；每个native_control_segments只累计一次，双臂同步为同一环境步。拒绝或未执行计划为0。defer_llm的实际环境步计入总action，并另列non_model_controls。
audit_auxiliary.frame_mapping: 各执行阶段录制n_controls+1帧；frame为0基，视频25fps。env_start_boundary为前置累计边界，执行步为(start,end]。视频段拼接含边界帧，视频秒不等于真实墙钟耗时。证据区间是动作覆盖范围，不是精确物理事件起止帧。
audit_auxiliary.budget_interpretation: 动作预算与turn预算独立判断，遵循用户原始统计要求。总action上限缺失，两项action放弃指标null/unknown；turn上限原生max_decisions=100，可独立核查。协议§3.2“相关四项一律unknown”存在歧义，本包显式保留turn结果，未据action缺失将turn信息一并抹去。
audit_auxiliary.coverage: 阶段性结果：69个run、207路视频尚未完成三视角全程观看。全量4195条轨迹和38348控制步已重新核对；207路视频完整解码、690源文件哈希通过。18项视觉指标逐run标pending，不能按NA或0统计；旧版局部事件证据另存。

groups.name: persistent-cap20
groups.coverage: 动作前观测 + 视频片段补查

setting.label: persistent-cap20
setting.source: result.json → protocol / model / evidence.config.parameters（42 条一致）
notes: 42 条运行的设置逐条核对一致；仅每 run 的 manifest/hash 字段不同。

methodology: 检查42个case的result.json执行轨迹与三路MP4。校验2,674轮动作前观测、8,022张三视角图像；视觉复核覆盖每次夹爪指令及相邻观测、换手与观察动作。疑难提拉/失持及直接换手另查看视频内采样帧，部分片段逐帧加密；并非逐帧穷尽观看全部视频。
空夹后重试：实际闭合但未形成有效抓取，之后对同一物体重新接近或重试；可跨轮次或换臂。仅发出闭合计划、未执行闭合不计；最终空夹且没有后续重试不计此类。
夹取后掉落：物体离开支撑并随手运动，随后在主动松爪前失持。同一物体一次失持只计一次。主动释放后的倒下或落偏归放置失败。
待确认：夹指遮挡或支撑接触不清，使空夹、支撑滑移、短暂提起后掉落无法可靠区分；不进入确认空夹或确认掉落。因此确认数是保守计数，0表示未确认发现。
换手按同一物体跨左右手计。分别记录桌面中转、任务支撑面中转、直接稳定成功、直接尝试失败和掉落后另一手恢复。直接稳定成功要求供给手释放后接收手继续保持并执行后续动作；实际接近受阻也可构成失败尝试，纯文字计划不计。
补视野：另一臂实际移动以补足执行臂缺失的几何观察，包含观察臂撤离以恢复可见性；执行臂自看、常规闲臂扫描、仅清运动路径和被拒未动均排除。同一未解决缺口的连续调整计一轮；恢复执行后再次出现缺口计新一轮。动作数按实际运动的轨迹turn计。
cap20可能截断移动或夹爪动作。统计结合executed_waypoints、后续夹爪状态和图像，不以请求targets或accepted作为实际完成证据。模型note只作定位线索，不单独证明夹取或掉落。
T为本报告1起始轨迹序号；P为原始policy_step；E为动作前env_step；F为各MP4内0起始帧号，F不等于E。执行视频帧区间为[start,end)。事件列出的T覆盖动作前、动作与后续结果，非每个T各计一次。
原生分数原样保留；完全成功数按score==1计算。补充发现仅是检查中遇到的示例，未对碰撞、放置失败、洒漏等作穷尽统计。当前数量是事件数，不是以抓取机会数为分母的失败率。
与semantic-eef旧报告比较时须注意证据差异：本组有连续视频补查，旧组主要基于稀疏动作前图像；待确认事件占比和可确认事件数会受此影响。

configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.

configuration.model_action_horizon.prompt: Every move_eef call must include num_actions, an integer from {min_actions} to {max_actions}. It selects how many native control actions from the start of the original planned and retimed trajectory may execute before the next observation. It is not a distance, a number of model decisions, or a request to resample the trajectory. Execute at most min(num_actions, plan length); native termination may stop execution earlier. Discard the unused suffix; it never executes automatically. Use fewer actions near state changes such as contact, grasping, release or object motion, during precise operations, or when missing information makes the situation highly uncertain. Use more for predictable motion when sufficient information is available. Fewer actions may stop before your requested position or orientation, or before a scheduled gripper change. Inspect the next measured observation and arrival feedback instead of assuming the target was reached, then choose the next target and num_actions.
